| File | For |
|---|---|
| `sb4_send-momentum.fap` | Flipper Zero, Momentum mntm-012 |
| `sb4_send-api87.fap` | Flipper Zero, official firmware 1.4.x |
| `sb4_send-api88.fap` | Flipper Zero, official firmware 1.5.x |
| `P4SENDX.PRG` | SmileBASIC 4, tested on 4.4.9 |
| `p4pack.py`, `p4recv.py` | Python 3 with Pillow |

Copy the `.fap` to `apps/USB/` on the SD card. The [guide](https://github.com/ltlapy/p4sendx-tools/blob/main/docs/guide.md) covers the rest.
